steps.content: As you feel the soft and yielding texture underfoot, a wall of golden sand obscures your vision.

You look up to find the sky has narrowed. Frosted glass surrounds you on all sides while fine sand cascades from above, forming a golden path, suffocating you. It seems Eleanor has dragged you into flowing sand. Is it the hourglass?
Outside, gunfire tears the sky apart, but bullets and heavy shells only create silent ripples against the glass walls, unable to leave even the slightest crack.

steps.speaker: Wynn
steps.content: What is this glass even made of?! Why can't we blast it open?! We can't get in, and Chief can't get out. What are we supposed to do?! Think of something, Eugene! Chief is being buried alive in there!

steps.speaker: Eugene
steps.content: I'm working on it. Chief is still in there, and there might be innocent civilians too, so we can't use heavy weaponry. Let's try other methods.

The Witch hovers in the air like she's watching a spectacle. You can see the anxious faces of Wynn and Eugene through the glass wall. With a casual flick of her index finger, the Aurum Secretum hourglass flips once more, erasing their recent victory and resetting your rescuers' progress to zero.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Is this... your ability?!

steps.speaker: Witch of Rewind
steps.content: After all, I am the Witch of Rewind. To me, time is merely an endless loop. You should be used to it by now, Chief, after playing this game for so long.

steps.speaker: Witch of Rewind
steps.content: Let them busy themselves for a while longer. Now, shall we have a peaceful talk?
She turns to face you, her gaze gentle. Meanwhile, sand fills your nose and throat, making each breath a desperate struggle.
With a delicate wave of her sleeve, she brushes the sand off your face, then cups your cheeks and lifts your face to meet her gaze.

steps.speaker: Witch of Rewind
steps.content: Chief, you've really been through quite a few extraordinary things. You spend every day wrestling with Mania and Corruptors, dealing with the various factions, protecting the fragile peace amid DisCity's dark currents... You bear the weighty responsibility of an entire city's fate.

steps.speaker: Witch of Rewind
steps.content: "Sinner Detention Expert," "Owner of the Absolute Power," "West District's Liberator," "Black Ring Terminator"... These titles are proof of your journey so far. And you'll only collect even more in the future, won't you?

steps.speaker: Witch of Rewind
steps.content: But most people's lives are more like an hourglass. Day after day, from one end to another, rinse and repeat. There's rarely ever anything special.
Her smile fades slightly as she lowers her voice, a faint trace of pity in her tone.

steps.speaker: Witch of Rewind
steps.content: ...Your life is forever colorful, filled with grand adventures. You're brave and resolute. It's in your nature to press forward through storms and achieve one brilliant victory after another. It's truly remarkable.

steps.speaker: Witch of Rewind
steps.content: But it's precisely because of this that you might struggle to fully understand the daily lives of ordinary people... That's an entirely different feeling, one you may not be familiar with.

steps.speaker: Witch of Rewind
steps.content: For them, life is the repetitive daily commute, the darkness greeting them when they finally get off long hours of work, the jaded loneliness and resignation they can tell no one... These must all sound trivial to you, right? But during those quiet hours every night, the emptiness in their hearts grows ever larger.

steps.speaker: Witch of Rewind
steps.content: With so many people trusting you, depending on you, loving you, it's only natural that you cannot comprehend this kind of loneliness... You and most ordinary people have never been on the same path.
She dissects your past, laying it bare on the sand to be scorched mercilessly by the blazing sun. Yet her tone is ever so gentle, her eyes seemingly filled with admiration for you.
Her hand travels downward, gliding past your neck to your chest. Her fingertips tap on your name tag through the thin fabric, the crisp clink quickening your heartbeat.

steps.speaker: Witch of Rewind
steps.content: Clay doesn't lead a happy life, and he wants strength and security. Ezra lacks emotional connections with others, and he wants a friend who understands him. That young girl, Eleanor, despite her carefree life, craves excitement and novelty beyond the everyday routine.

steps.speaker: Witch of Rewind
steps.content: You see, what keeps everyone here isn't <color=#fb9259>Mania</color>, but those small yet genuine wishes that haven't been fully extinguished by their draining, repetitive lives.

steps.speaker: Witch of Rewind
steps.content: To tell you the truth, I quite enjoy seeing you immersing yourself fully in my script.
Why is she so fixated on helping people escape their ordinary real lives? To the point of fabricating a personalized story for each of them?

options: Is making up stories your own form of escapism?
Are you glorifying Mania? Is this just another lie to deceive me?

steps.content: Your question makes her hand freeze, the smile at the corners of her mouth slowly fading away. Did you strike a nerve?
Doubted by you, she closes her eyes and sighs, giving you a resigned smile as she withdraws her hand from you.

steps.speaker: Witch of Rewind
steps.content: Anyway, since you reject this story, your journey should end here.

The conversation reaches an impasse, but more pressing now is your predicament. The sand continues to pour relentlessly from above, already covering your waist, then your chest, gradually piling up to your neck.
Perhaps she's waiting for you to panic, to beg for mercy, to be completely submerged by the sand. Then, you'll become just another NPC in her looping script, forgetting who you truly are in reality.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...If what you say is true, that <color=#fb9259>the Witch's story</color> captivates people by "fulfilling their desires," then this shouldn't be how it ends.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: My days of chasing troublemakers like you may seem exciting to you. But for me, that life is filled with stress and fear. The ordinary existence you find so empty and boring is exactly what I dream of, and what so many people fight for.
You fix a defiant gaze on the Witch.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Today I came here wishing to experience a peaceful, ordinary life, but instead your god-awful story has dragged me right back into work mode.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: When this is over, I'm definitely giving you a one-star review.
Surprise flickers in the Witch's eyes. Seizing this momentary opening, you wrench one arm free and cast your shackles on her.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Besides, you haven't fulfilled <color=#fb9259>everyone else's</color> wishes either!

Your "Anomaly" name tag is searing your chest through the pocket. You could have refused this tag, but if it truly represents an unknowable, invisible, and uncontrollable role, then now is the time to try your luck with this random ability.

Boom! As if responding to your words, several beams of white light suddenly unfold around you, followed immediately by a massive figure leaping out of the radiance, cleaving through the sand trapping you with an ax.

steps.speaker: Butcher
steps.content: Raaah!

steps.speaker: Witch of Rewind
steps.content: It's you?!
Air rushes back into your lungs, making you cough violently. But the sand quickly reforms into arms, striking at you with howling wind.

The Butcher charges forward, swinging his ax again and again. But the sand quickly gathers, impossible to cut down completely... He's already panting, yet has managed to create an escape route for you.

steps.speaker: Butcher
steps.content: I was blinded by my ax and made the wrong judgment... Just killing the Witch might not be enough.

Finally, he sprints and smashes his ax against the hourglass wall. Empowered by the skill the Witch herself has granted him, the previously invincible glass surface finally starts to crack. The glass shatters, reversing the swirl of the sand.

steps.speaker: Butcher
steps.content: But... saving someone can never be wrong, can it?

The Witch is about to raise her hand when she discovers something clinging to her left arm. A candle hand. It shakes urgently, its flame and wax anxiously swaying and splashing, conveying the desperate state of its owner.
It's Rumina. Through the hourglass wall, she silently calls out to the Witch.
The Witch is about to raise her hand when a pale yet firm hand suddenly emerges from the sand at her feet, gripping her ankle.

steps.speaker: Witch of Rewind
steps.content: Ezra! Why?

steps.speaker: Clergyman
steps.content: I'm staying here, hoping to fulfill my friend's wish.
The real wish...
Ezra struggles to lift his head. He speaks slowly, yet each word is hammered into the echo of the hourglass like a nail.

The Witch is momentarily distracted, causing Eleanor's grip on you to loosen. A pair of strong arms grabs you by the collar, yanks you out of the sand, and hurls you toward the gap! You're getting closer and closer to the exit! You lift your heavy legs and run with all your might.

The Witch quickly regains her focus. The sand gathers into an extended arm that slams the Butcher against the surface. Even the Clergyman, who's finally gotten half of his body out, is covered by sand once more, unable to reach the Witch again.
Having lost his ax, the Butcher fights the sand with bare hands. Eleanor, now the Witch's Devotee, tries to stop you, but the Butcher grabs her firmly, dragging her into the swirling sand with him.

steps.speaker: Butcher
steps.content: Killed you a few times. Sorry about that.

steps.speaker: Butcher
steps.content: Good luck, Chief. When you win, don't forget to give me some credit.
The Butcher sinks deeper and deeper. First his legs, then his body, and finally his head. Looking in your direction, he grins widely, points at you, then makes a fist and proudly thumps his chest.
The sand closes in, completely swallowing him. This man finally fulfills his promise at the last moment. He has protected you.
